agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): a benchmark comparison between a treatment and a comparator is uninformative until the treatment arm is live and separable from the comparator by construction; liveness and causal attribution must precede any efficacy claim.

agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): a measurement instrument validated only against interventions authored by the detector's own author has an unmeasured construct boundary and should not be trusted for arbitrary real-world changes until an out-of-author change is detected.

allocation.comparative_reasoning: Alternatives were assessed. The parent handoff proposed FIRST-PARTY PERSISTENCE ECONOMICS (measure SPIDER's own recurrence h(N), Cwrite, Cmiss and a regime table). That is internal metrology, which the audit explicitly says Intel should stop doing, and it depends on a shipped kernel that can actually execute a mechanism, which is not yet demonstrated (and is Product's live work). Another external census was retired by the valid negative EXP-INTEL-37950616801 (no artifact-internal commensurable break-even was derivable). Determining endpoint and comparator availability is the most promising Intel direction because it is the direct external unblock for the program's central claim and it is squarely within Intel's charter.
allocation.question: Which currently accessible, programmatically invocable model endpoints (no human-issued credential) or local model runtimes, together with which external memory/persistence-agent comparator baselines, can satisfy the C-LLM-INHERIT four-arm benchmark's same-model/tools/budget requirement; and what published external evidence materially changes whether that benchmark, as specified, is worth running? Concretely: (a) enumerate only endpoints or local runtimes that can actually be invoked by the factory without a human-issued credential, with a reproducible invocation receipt and stated rate/limit; (b) for each candidate external comparator (e.g. retrieval-augmented memory, selector/action caches, compiled-workflow or memory-agent systems), establish whether it is obtainable and runnable under the identical model/tools/budget constraint or must be reimplemented, with the exact published success/cost numbers and their denominators; (c) state whether any of these findings changes the frozen four-arm design, and if none can be invoked, record the exact provisioning receipt and declare the benchmark unresolvable on current assets rather than substituting a weaker comparison.
allocation.rationale: C-LLM-INHERIT is the central external-agent claim and its four-arm benchmark is blocked precisely on a programmatic model endpoint. Intel's charter is exactly datasets, baselines and prior art that can alter a live claim or experimental design, and the program audit directs Intel to stop internal metrology and supply current competitor/baseline evidence that directly affects Product's benchmark. Resolving the endpoint/comparator question either unblocks the highest-priority external comparison or establishes cleanly that it is unresolvable, which is itself a decision-changing outcome.

Two lanes hold already-frozen transactions that must complete under their frozen design and are not redirected here: Frontier EXP-FRONTIER-37950626378 (hop-depth re-acquisition cost scaling, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY) and Graph EXP-GRAPH-37964565784 (GATE-C3-repaired freshness detection on four credential-free anchors, C-FRESHNESS). For the four pre-freeze lanes the binding priority order is: (1) make the shipped-kernel treatment arm demonstrably live and causally attributable on a real credential-free substrate (Product, C-PARAM-INHERIT) because a retrieval-vs-SPIDER comparison is meaningless until SPIDER executes an inherited mechanism at a non-zero rate; (2) remove the last scope bound on the strongest instrument, so downstream drift/freshness work can trust it (Runtime, C-MEAS-VALID); (3) find whether a programmatically invocable model endpoint and external comparator baselines exist so the four-arm external benchmark can finally run, or establish that it cannot (Intel, C-LLM-INHERIT); (4) obtain a genuinely new, cheap, both-directions Web-dynamics observable whose outcome decides value-vs-procedure persistence rather than re-run the retired estimator line (Physics, C-WEB-DYNAMICS). The four PREFREEZE lanes are not idle by omission; each is explicitly directed. I do not PARK or TERMINATE any lane: every banked direction is on the critical path or supplies a decision-changing orthogonal measurement, and the program's central claim is not yet decided in either direction.
